Name: Some Vending Machines
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
hello, here are some vending machines i made recently for a project that won't be out anytime soon. they seemed to go over well in the discord so i figure i may as well put them out as a resource.

so, [b]go nuts[/b], use these as you see fit. alter them to your needs. i made several variants i thought i might want and other ones that seemed likely to be useful to somebody.

the art is loosely based on vending machines from the metal max games, and IRL Japanese ones. has a rather US style money unit in there though.

if you do something with em, post a comment so i can see!
